children: Transocean announced a two-well, ~170-day contract for the Deepwater Conqueror adding about $80 million of backlog.
Deepwater Conqueror awarded two-well contract in Equatorial Guinea with an undisclosed operator.
Estimated 170-day campaign expected to start in 2027 in direct continuation of the rig’s U.S. Gulf contract.
Contract contributes approximately $80 million in backlog, excluding additional services and mobilization/demobilization fees.
Announcement incorporated via Exhibit 99.1; forward-looking statements subject to customary risks and uncertainties.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Transocean secures $80M, 170-day two-well contract for Deepwater Conqueror in Equatorial Guinea
